# inngest_apps (Data Source)

Lists the apps of an Inngest environment.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "inngest_apps" "production" {
  environment = "production"
}

output "app_function_counts" {
  value = { for a in data.inngest_apps.production.apps : a.id => a.function_count }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `archived` (Boolean) List archived apps instead of active ones. Defaults to `false`.
- `environment` (String) Environment to list apps for, sent as the `X-Inngest-Env` header. Defaults to the provider's `environment`; when neither is set, the API uses the production environment.

### Read-Only

- `apps` (Attributes List) The apps, in the order the API returns them. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps))

<a id="nestedatt--apps"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps`

Read-Only:

- `app_version` (String) User-defined app version, if set.
- `archived` (Boolean) Whether the app is archived.
- `archived_at` (String) When the app was archived (RFC 3339), if it is.
- `created_at` (String) When the app was first synced (RFC 3339).
- `function_count` (Number) Number of functions in the app.
- `id` (String) The user-defined app ID.
- `latest_sync` (Attributes) The latest sync of the app, if any. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--apps--latest_sync))
- `method` (String) How the app connects: `UNSPECIFIED`, `SERVE`, `CONNECT`, `API` or `INNGEST_SERVE`.
- `name` (String) App name.

<a id="nestedatt--apps--latest_sync"></a>
### Nested Schema for `apps.latest_sync`

Read-Only:

- `app_version` (String) App version reported by the sync.
- `error` (String) Most recent sync or connection error, if any.
- `framework` (String) Framework reported by the SDK, such as `nextjs`.
- `sdk_language` (String) Language of the SDK, such as `typescript`.
- `sdk_version` (String) Version of the SDK.
- `status` (String) Sync status: `pending`, `success`, `error` or `duplicate`.
- `synced_at` (String) Time of the sync (RFC 3339).
- `url` (String) URL of the app's Inngest endpoint, if synced by URL.
